one_liner: Lark offers a REST API with bearer token authentication for custom apps.
gating_notes: Developers must create a custom app in the Lark Developer Console and obtain a tenant_access_token; no public API key or OAuth flow is provided.
oauth_details: None – authentication is via tenant_access_token obtained after app creation.

auth_methods.quote: The access token is the key to accessing the Lark Open Platform, binding the caller identity, as well as all data access and API call permissions obtained by the app together, allowing the app to perform read and write operations on resources.
